content_sections.heading: TNRD (tnrd.tn.gov.in) Recruitment 2026 - Village Panchayat Secretary Overview
TNRD Village Panchayat Secretary Recruitment 2026 Notification
content_sections.text: The Commissioner of Rural Development and Panchayat Raj has issued a departmental communication dated 20 November 2026 to District Collectors (Development Wing) across Tamil Nadu, excluding Chennai, regarding the recruitment of Village Panchayat Secretaries. According to the recruitment timetable, applications will be received for a period of 15 days from 4 December to 18 December 2026. The recruitment process is scheduled to conclude with the issuance of appointment orders on 27 January 2027. The newspaper report published on 25 November 2026 also provides information regarding educational qualifications, salary, application fees and the recruitment schedule. Candidates should refer to the upcoming district-wise official recruitment notifications for complete eligibility conditions and vacancy details.

content_sections.heading: TNRD Village Panchayat Secretary Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment drive aims to fill vacant Village Panchayat Secretary posts in districts across Tamil Nadu, excluding Chennai. The department will publish district-wise and village panchayat-wise vacancy information on its official website. The total number of vacancies has not been specified in the available recruitment schedule. Candidates are advised to check the respective district recruitment notifications for the exact vacancy count and reservation details.

content_sections.heading: TNRD Village Panchayat Secretary Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed SSLC (10th Standard). Candidates must have studied the Tamil language. Applicants must satisfy the additional eligibility conditions prescribed in the official recruitment notification. The age limit and category-wise age relaxation applicable to the December 2026 recruitment cycle should be checked in the detailed official notification.

content_sections.heading: TNRD Village Panchayat Secretary Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: As per the departmental recruitment schedule, the selection process will involve scrutiny of applications, preparation of the shortlist, interviews and publication of selection results. Scrutiny of Applications Preparation of Shortlisted Candidates List Interview Publication of Selection Results Issuance of Appointment Orders For village panchayats where applications have already been received, the existing 1:5 shortlist will be retained. Newly applying candidates who secure marks equal to or higher than those of the last shortlisted candidate will be added to the list. For newly added vacancies, applications will be received in accordance with the applicable communal reservation roster. The available recruitment schedule does not mention a written examination.

How to Apply for TNRD Village Panchayat Secretary Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can follow the steps given below once the application process begins on 4 December 2026. Visit the official TNRD website at tnrd.tn.gov.in . Locate the Village Panchayat Secretary Recruitment 2026 notification. Check the district-wise vacancy details and eligibility requirements. Access the application form for the relevant district or village panchayat. Fill in the required personal and educational details. Submit the required documents and pay the applicable application fee as instructed. Complete the application process before 18 December 2026. Keep a copy of the submitted application for future reference.
